    Astronomer.java - Represents a famous astronomer known throughout history. Description: Each astronomer is identified by their name, where born, the most famous theory associated with them, and the estimated year of their birth. Instance variables: name (String) - name of the astronomer country (String) - country of birth theory (String) - description of famous theory born (int) - year born (CE) - Section in class Astronomer
